title: fix(fields): the line grid draws no blank entry row beside Add, and its column headers show each field's help
body:
Fixes #35507
Fixes #35804

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 在主从表单的明细行表格里，业务用户编辑报价、订单时：以前已有行下面总多一条删不掉的空白行，现在只显示真实的行；每列表头旁多了一个小图标，鼠标悬停或用键盘移上去就显示该字段的填写说明。
- 属于体验改进，替通过明细表格录入的业务用户解决"空白行像坏行"和"填写规则在表格里看不到"这两个问题。
- 出错时最坏是表格里少了空白录入行或说明图标不显示，保存发送的内容不变，可以直接撤回本次改动。
- 无。

## What changes

**#35507: no blank entry row beside "Add line".** `GridField` used to append an always-present empty "ghost" line under the lines (`hasGhost` / `displayRows`), directly above the Add button. It had no copy or remove action and produced no write. The grid no longer draws it.
- Premise as measured on `origin/main` (`9a8bb83d`): the ghost row and the Add button were both gated on `allowAdd`, so the ghost was **only ever drawn where Add was drawn**. Dropping it leaves no grid without a way to add a line. The "Add not drawn" branch of the order has nothing to restyle: with `allowAdd: false` there was never a ghost row, and that stays true (CONTROL pin).
- An empty editable grid now shows the existing `fields.grid.noItemsAddHint` ("No items yet — click "Add line" to begin.") with the Add button's real label. No new i18n key.
- Keyboard path kept. On main a keyboard user could Tab or Enter into the ghost line and type. Now: **Add moves focus into the line it appends** (Tab reaches Add after the last line), and **Enter in the last line appends a line and moves to the same column in it** (only when adding is allowed).
- One narrow state still draws the entry line: a **required grid the form refused while empty** (`hostFailedEmpty`, objectui#3318). There the line carries the field's failure to assistive tech on the cells a user types into. The Add button is an action, not the invalid control. `widget-aria-invalid-registry-e2e` stays green because this line still exists.
- Saving is unchanged. An edit emits exactly the lines (CONTROL pin), and a line added through Add then typed sends the same create the ghost line did. 23 plugin-form test files read the ghost line as the entry path. Each one now presses Add first, with the expected lengths and the batch payloads unchanged.

**#35804: column headers show each field's help.** Each grid column header now draws an info icon beside its label when the field has help. The help shows on hover and on keyboard focus (Radix tooltip), and the icon button's accessible name is the help text. The editable grid and the read-only table both draw it.
- Help source: a grid column (`InlineGridColumn`) is a strict spec shape with no help key. No spec key is added. Following the `lookupAutofill` / `columnCurrencies` pattern, the host that holds the child object's definition passes the help through a new `GridField` prop, `columnHelp`. New helper: `columnHelpByField(fields)`. It reads each field through `fieldHelpText`, the same function the record form's help line uses (`inlineHelpText`, else `description`), so the header and the form show the same text.
- The child definition is the one `dataSource.getObjectSchema(child)` serves, which the record form also reads. The server applies `objectExtensions.fieldPatches` before serving it and translates the help into the reader's locale (`packages/rest/src/meta-object-field-patch-i18n.test.ts` pins both on the served object). The grid does not re-resolve anything.
- Wired in the three line-grid hosts: `MasterDetailForm`, `LineItemsPanel` and `RecordBodyTableEditor`.

## Tests

All runs are at head `d4100395`, through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.
- New pins in `GridField.test.tsx` (two top-level describes) and `MasterDetailForm.test.tsx` (one describe).
- On the base, the 9 non-control pins were red: `9 failed | 59 passed`. The four CONTROL pins (Add off, edit emit, Enter with Add off, no-help header) were green on both trees.
- `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/ packages/plugin-form/`: **Test Files 549 passed | 1 skipped (550), Tests 7402 passed | 8 skipped (7410)**, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields run type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form run type-check` both passed after building their `@object-ui` dependency closure. VERDICT command-exit 0.

<details><summary>Ablations (one per fix, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob)</summary>

- Ghost row back (`hasGhost` without `hostFailedEmpty`): 4 pins red (lines-only, empty state, Add focus, Enter append) and 3 controls green. Restore: blob `1a5224d841fb` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Header help off (`ColumnHeaderHelp` returns null): 5 pins red (accessible name, focus tooltip, read-only table, and both MasterDetailForm host cases). Restore: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
</details>

## Browser reading (A4)

This run used the showcase on its own `--fresh` backend (:4371) and the Console dev server (:5371) built from this branch, in headless Chromium at 1280×900 with deviceScaleFactor 2. The invoice INV-1010 edit form has one stored line. For the reading only, two fixtures were added and then reverted (neither is in this PR): a declared `inlineHelpText` on `showcase_invoice_line.quantity`, and an object extension whose `fieldPatches` set `unit_price.inlineHelpText` to 「内销填含税价，出口填不含税的 FOB 美元价」.
- tbody rows: 1, the stored line only. The row above Add line is "1 · Widget B · … · $230.00", with no blank trailing row.
- Help icons: `Qty *` is named "Whole units; bill partial hours as decimals." (declared), and `Unit Price` is named 「内销填含税价，出口填不含税的 FOB 美元价」 (fieldPatches). Other headers have no icon.
- Hovering the Unit Price icon shows a tooltip with the patched text. Keyboard focus on the Qty icon shows a tooltip with the declared text, and `activeElement`'s accessible name is that help.
- Clicking Add line leaves the focus on `data-cell="1-1"` (Description) of the new line. The first column is a lookup with no text cell.
- Screenshots (seat share): `a4-35507/1-edit-form-no-trailing-row.png`, `2-grid-no-trailing-row.png`, `3-hover-help-fieldPatches-unit-price.png`, `4-focus-help-declared-qty.png`, `5-after-add-focus-in-new-line.png`.

## Acceptance notes

- File surface: the claim names `GridField.tsx`, its tests, i18n keys and a changeset. This PR also touches `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx` (one export line), the three host files (`MasterDetailForm.tsx`, `LineItemsPanel.tsx`, `RecordBodyTableEditor.tsx`, which pass `columnHelp`), and 23 plugin-form test files that typed into the removed ghost line. These include `discardGuard.test.tsx` and `__tests__/modalMaximize-34604.test.tsx`, which exercise ModalForm; `ModalForm.tsx` itself is untouched. The order's direction for #35804 (find the resolved source the form uses) cannot be met from `GridField.tsx` alone, because the grid holds no field definition.
- Reach of the help: a master-detail entry whose `relationshipField` and every column `type` are authored loads no child schema (an existing short-circuit in `MasterDetailForm`), so its headers show no help, just as it gets no `lookupAutofill`. The console's own path (`inlineColumns` names, hydrated from the child schema) loads it, and the showcase reading above went through that path.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx`: the `hasGhost` / `hostFailedEmpty` hunk and `pendingFocus` / `addRow` / `onCellKeyDown`.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx`: `columnHelp` at both resolve sites and on the grid.
3. `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.test.tsx`: the two new top-level describes.

Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.test.tsx -t "objectstack#35(507|804)"` should print 12 passed (the new pins).
